# BlissFruitz — AI-Readable Site Information

> BlissFruitz is a premium fresh fruits and dry fruits e-commerce delivery service based in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.

## About
BlissFruitz delivers handpicked seasonal fruits, exotic imports, and premium dry fruits directly to customers' doorsteps across Mumbai. We source from certified organic farms and ensure farm-to-fork freshness within 24 hours.

## Products
- **Fresh Fruits**: Seasonal Indian fruits (Alphonso Mango, Kesar Mango, Pomegranate, etc.), Exotic imports (Dragon Fruit, Avocado, Kiwi, Blueberries)
- **Dry Fruits**: Premium Cashews, Almonds, Pistachios, Walnuts, Raisins, Dates, Mixed dry fruit gift boxes
- **Seasonal Specials**: Mango season (April–June), Litchi (May–June), Strawberry (Dec–Feb)

## Delivery
- **Coverage**: All areas of Mumbai (Andheri, Bandra, Juhu, Powai, Thane, Borivali, Dadar, and more)
- **Speed**: Same-day delivery available for orders placed before 2 PM
- **Minimum Order**: No minimum order requirement
